scope_conditions: llm-d/llm-d, docs/infrastructure/no-kubernetes-deployment.md, main branch, as of commit merged Jun 24, 2026
quoted_support: Without Kubernetes, some pieces of the llm-d stack are out of scope: InferenceObjective-driven FlowControl, the InferenceModelRewrite model-name rewriter, and PodMonitor-based Prometheus discovery. Scoring, prefix-cache affinity, saturation-based admission, and Prometheus metrics on --metrics-port all work.

claim: The motivating non-Kubernetes environments named by the design doc are HPC schedulers (Slurm, LSF) that launch workers dynamically, Ray-based stacks running workers as actors, bare-metal inference farms, and single-workstation development setups.
stance_target: the full set of target environments the llm-d project itself designed file-discovery to cover, beyond what the blog emphasized (blog focused mainly on RL/Slurm; this doc adds LSF explicitly)
scope_conditions: llm-d/llm-d, docs/infrastructure/no-kubernetes-deployment.md, main branch, as of commit merged Jun 24, 2026
quoted_support: Many environments don't have a Kubernetes control plane, though: HPC schedulers like Slurm or LSF launch workers dynamically, Ray-based stacks run workers as actors, bare-metal inference farms operate without K8s, and a single workstation with a couple of GPUs is often enough for development.
